basic_info.description: Located on a highly desirable and quiet cul-de-sac in the Corona Heights neighborhood, 27 Saturn St is a modern Single Family Home with panoramic views of the rolling city skyline, the bay, Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower. This 3 bed + Office, 2 bath home has incredible natural light, an updated kitchen, air conditioning, a one-car garage, 2 large decks, a beautiful garden with a terrace and garden shed, ample storage and laundry. The top level showcases a large south-facing open kitchen, living room, and dining room layout with a skylight and oversized windows that walk out to an expansive view deck. The top level also has 2 beds and 1 bath. The entry level consists of the spacious primary bedroom with a large walk out deck and en-suite bathroom. The bottom level has an office/flex use space with closets and extra storage. A highly sought-after location, 27 Saturn enjoys immediate naturally beautiful suburban-style surroundings, but is also remarkably convenient and nearby to some of San Francisco's premier parks, retail and dining corridors, public transportation, and the Saturn Street Steps.
